evidence: Labeled 'Build system' and modifies Guix release build scripts under contrib/guix/ and depends/.
rationale: Compiling non-GUI Linux release binaries with `-static-pie` resolves portability barriers on non-glibc systems like Alpine and older distributions. As noted in the release notes, release binaries 'can now be run on non-glibc based systems, as well as on systems that ship with older glibcs', solving longstanding compatibility issues (#19075) without needing dynamic loader shims.
